author: GodEmperorDoge
name: Watch
short: Preload media, request downloads and import public Spotify playlists.
description: Owner-permitted movie/TV and music acquisition, public Jellyfin playlists, per-user TV season retention and durable completion notifications.
install_msg: Set the API token with the PRELOAD_BOT_TOKEN environment variable or `[p]set api media_preload token,<token>` (and url,<url> if it isn't http://host.containers.internal:8125).
end_user_data_statement: Stores a linked Jellyfin name, download permission, TV season choices, playlist source-to-Jellyfin ID mappings, and requester/channel/job metadata. Completed job details expire after seven days; mappings persist for safe reimports. Red user-data deletion removes these records without deleting shared media or public Jellyfin playlists.
